protocols.description: List of enabled protocols. Common: imap, pop3, lmtp, submission.

listen.description: IP addresses or hostnames to listen on. Use ['*'] for IPv4 only, ['::'] for IPv6 only.

disable_plaintext_auth.description: Set to true to reject authentication unless TLS is active. Critical for security.

mail_location.description: Mailbox storage format and path. Use 'mbox:~/mbox' for mbox format or 'maildir:~/Maildir' for Maildir.

auth_mechanisms.description: SASL authentication mechanisms to support. Prefer SCRAM-SHA-256 or external certs in production.

passdb.description: Password database configuration. Driver typically 'passwd-file', 'sql', or 'pam'. This block is generated if defined in services or global passdb settings.

userdb.description: User database configuration. Often mirrors passdb for simple setups. This block is generated if defined in services or global userdb settings.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS settings. Set mode to 'required' to enforce encryption.

mail_max_userip_connections.description: Max concurrent connections per user/IP. Default is 10.

log_path.description: Path to the Dovecot log file.

services.description: Service definitions for Dovecot login processes (e.g., imap-login, submission-login, pop3-login). Each defines how login daemons run.

imap_max_line_length.description: Max IMAP line length in bytes. Increase for large IMAP folders or long ACL lists.

auth_verbose.description: Log additional details on auth attempts (useful for troubleshooting, may leak info in logs).

auth_debug.description: Enable verbose auth debugging. Not for production use.
